privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy matters to us, and we are committed to handling your data responsibly

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.content: Mr aqar is committed to respecting your privacy and protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, manage, and safeguard your data when you interact with our platform and services.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.description: To operate effectively, we may collect different categories of information:
collection.personal: Personal Details: Information such as your name, email, phone number, and any details you provide while creating an account or using our services.
collection.usage: Activity Data: Information about how you browse, search, or interact with features on our platform.
collection.technical: Device & Technical Data: This includes IP address, device type, browser details, and system information.
collection.cookies: Cookies & Similar Technologies: Small data files used to remember preferences and enhance your browsing experience.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
use.description: We process your information for purposes such as:
items: Delivering and maintaining platform functionality
Improving features and overall user experience
Responding to your messages, requests, or support needs
Sending relevant notifications, updates, or offers
Analyzing usage trends to enhance performance
Meeting legal or regulatory obligations

sharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.description: We respect your privacy and do not trade your personal data. Information may only be shared in limited situations such as:
items: With trusted partners who assist in running our services
When required by applicable laws or legal authorities
To protect the security, rights, or safety of our platform and users
With your explicit permission when necessary

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.content: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect your personal data from unauthorized access, misuse, or loss. While we strive to use commercially acceptable methods to secure information, no digital system can guarantee absolute security.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.description: Depending on applicable regulations, you may have the following rights:
rights.access: Access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
rights.correction: Correction: You can ask us to update or fix inaccurate or incomplete information.
rights.deletion: Deletion: You can request removal of your personal data under certain conditions.
rights.transfer: Data Portability: You may request your data in a structured, commonly used format.
rights.object: Objection: You may object to certain types of data processing where applicable.

cookies_info.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies_info.content: Our platform uses cookies and related technologies to improve usability, remember preferences, and understand user behavior. You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

retention.title: 8. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain personal information only for as long as it is necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. When no longer needed, data is securely deleted or anonymized.

changes.title: 9. Updates to This Policy
changes.content: We may revise this Privacy Policy occasionally to reflect updates in our services, legal requirements, or operational practices. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised date.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions, feedback, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please reach out to us:

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Please review these terms before using our platform

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using Mr aqar, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the platform or its services.

definitions.title: 2. Definitions
definitions.service: Platform: Refers to the Mr aqar website, mobile application, and all related services.
definitions.user: User: Any person or entity accessing or using the platform, including individuals and real estate offices.
definitions.content: Content: All listings, text, images, data, or materials published on the platform.
definitions.account: Account: A registered profile created by a user to access platform features.

eligibility.title: 3. Eligibility
eligibility.description: To use Mr aqar, you confirm that:
items: You are legally capable of entering into binding agreements
You meet the minimum age requirement under applicable law
You are not restricted from using such services under relevant regulations
You provide accurate and truthful information during registration

registration.title: 4. Account Responsibilities
registration.description: When creating and maintaining an account, you agree to:
items: Provide up-to-date and correct information
Keep your login credentials secure and confidential
Inform us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account
Update your details whenever necessary
Accept responsibility for all activities performed under your account

use.title: 5. Acceptable Use
use.description: You agree to use the platform responsibly. The following activities are not allowed:
items: Violating applicable laws or regulations
Posting false, misleading, or harmful content
Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the system
Disrupting or interfering with platform functionality
Using the platform outside its intended purpose without permission
Infringing on intellectual property or legal rights of others

property.title: 6. Intellectual Property
property.content: All platform elements, including design, branding, and system content, are owned or licensed by Mr aqar and are protected by applicable laws. You may not copy, reuse, or distribute any material without prior written approval.

user_content.title: 7. User Content
user_content.description: By submitting content to the platform, you agree that:
items: You are responsible for the accuracy and legality of your content
Your content does not violate the rights of others
Mr aqar may display or manage your content for platform operation
We may remove or modify content that violates these terms or policies

transactions.title: 8. User Transactions
transactions.content: Mr aqar acts as a listing and communication platform only. We are not involved in agreements, negotiations, or payments between users. Users are responsible for verifying all details before completing any transaction.

paid_services.title: 9. Paid Features
items: Fees are clearly displayed before purchase
Payments are generally non-refundable unless stated otherwise
Pricing may change at any time
We reserve the right to modify or discontinue paid features

termination.title: 10. Suspension or Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate access to your account if there is a violation of these terms or misuse of the platform. You may also stop using the platform at any time.

disclaimer.title: 11. Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: The platform is provided on an "as available" basis. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or the accuracy of all content. Use of the platform is at your own discretion and risk.

limitation.title: 12. Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: Mr aqar is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use of the platform or reliance on its content.

compensation.title: 13. Indemnification
compensation.content: You agree to indemnify and hold Mr aqar harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your misuse of the platform or violation of these terms.

law.title: 14. Governing Law
law.content: These terms are governed by applicable laws, and any disputes will be handled by the competent courts in the relevant jurisdiction.

amendments.title: 15. Updates to Terms
amendments.content: We may revise these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after updates means you accept the revised terms.

about.title: About Mr aqar
about.subtitle: A modern platform for real estate connections in Kuwait

whoWeAre.title: Company Information
whoWeAre.content: Mr aqar is part of a digital platform developed to support online property marketing in Kuwait. We focus on helping businesses and individuals present their real estate offerings in a more accessible and efficient way using modern technology.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To simplify how people discover, list, and connect around real estate by providing a reliable and easy-to-use digital environment.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our goal is to bridge the gap between property owners, real estate professionals, and seekers by offering tools that make listing, searching, and communication smooth and transparent.

owners.title: For Property Owners
owners.content: Owners and real estate offices can create listings, manage their properties, and communicate directly with interested users through the platform.

seekers.title: For Property Seekers
seekers.content: Users can explore available listings, filter based on their needs, and connect with advertisers to get more details or proceed further.

sell.title: Property Listings
sell.description: Easily publish and manage property advertisements.

rent.title: Rental Listings
rent.description: Support for listing rental properties with flexible details.

support.title: User Support
support.description: Assistance is available to help users navigate and use the platform effectively.

app.title: Cross-Platform Access
app.description: Accessible on web and mobile devices with a responsive interface.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: We welcome your feedback and are here to assist you.
